Fixed-alpha constants follow from gamma reflection. The recurrence diagnostics are reproducible but not a substitute for these infinite statements.

originality.rationale: The central uniform critical-window statement is a comparison of the actual reciprocal-kernel coefficients, not a restatement of qualitative complete-Pick positivity. The motivating 2026 article addresses the concavity implication; the 2022 Chalmoukis–Hartz paper gives the criterion and known positivity, not the logarithmic crossover. NIST supplies special-function expansions, not this uniform application. Searches of related complete-Pick polynomial-defect and polylogarithmic work did not find an equivalent or dominating theorem. General uniform renewal/Tauberian machinery remains an acknowledged possible implicit source.
residual_risks: A published uniform Tauberian/renewal theorem may already imply the exact crossover after a nontrivial substitution; the relevant general method was not exhaustively excluded.
The fixed-alpha and alpha=1 endpoint asymptotics are classical analytic consequences and are not individually presented as original.

value.rationale: The exact monomial-degree distribution is a canonical quantitative invariant of the normalized complete-Pick feature map, not an arbitrary numerical slice. The uniform boundary-layer profile resolves the singular transition from polynomial coefficient decay to 1/(n log^2 n) at the Dirichlet endpoint, a natural gap invisible to either fixed-parameter asymptotic alone.
